entries.title: Jeremiah 42:1
segments:
CHAP. XLII. 
 
  Johanan and the people desire Jeremiah to enquire of God, promising   obedience to his will, ver. 1-6.   Jeremiah assures them of safety in Judea, ver. 7-12.   and destruction in Egypt, ver. 13-18.   Reproves their hypocrisy and obstinacy, ver. 19-22.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:6
segments: V. 6. Good or evil-Whether grateful or ungrateful to us.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:10
segments: V. 10. I repent-I am satisfied with the punishment your nation hath undergone, and as to the remainder, will change the course of my providence.
